title: Sprengmeister-verkabelt-Sprengladungen
creator: Peterbuild
alt: In a rail tunnel under construction, a shotfirer in a hard hat with a cap lamp leans into the rock face and checks the wiring of the blast charges with gloved hands

hotspots.label: Cap lamp on the hard hat

notes: Hero since 11 Nov 2026 (the owner rejected the St Gallen thermite weld; that file is in assets/src/rejected/). Obertürkheim tunnel (Wangen–Obertürkheim section of Stuttgart 21, a rail project), Stuttgart, Germany; 2018-04-23 10:06 (EXIF, Canon EOS 7D). 3000×2000, exactly the 3000 px minimum. Caption (de): final check of the blast charges during drill-and-blast tunnelling. Why: one skilled worker, close side view, cap lamp on the hard hat, gloved hands on the detonator leads at the rock face, dim warm tunnel light. Mirror it (flop) so he leans in from the right; nothing readable in the frame. Caveats: the subject is explosives, which some investors may find edgy; face visible in profile; bare forearms (T-shirt) and no eye protection visible; slightly soft at 100 %. Licence re-checked on the Commons file page: {{self|cc-by-sa-4.0}}, own work by User:Peterbuild. There is no VRT ticket, and the page links an earlier copy on the uploader's own web host (now a dead link), so licence confidence is medium-high.

title: Thermite rail welding 32
creator: Cjp24

notes: Night track renewal, Neuvy-sur-Loire to Nevers line: grinding the outer face of a thermite weld, Port Aubry near Villechaud, Cosne-Cours-sur-Loire (Nièvre), France, 2017-07-13, 01:04. Dark frame with sparks and floodlight haze; plenty of black space for closing copy. title: MTA Prepares for Winter Storm
creator: Marc A. Hermann / MTA (Metropolitan Transportation Authority of the State of New York)
alt: A subway car equipment maintainer in a blue hard hat, safety glasses and white work gloves kneels beside the truck (bogie) of a New York subway car and works on the third-rail shoe beam, fitting a yellow ice-scraper shoe.
notes: Coney Island Maintenance Facility, Brooklyn, New York, USA; 2020-12-15. MTA New York City Transit Car Equipment Maintainers installing ice-scraper shoes on an R160 train before a winter storm (depot bogie work). Face in profile behind a COVID-era face mask and safety glasses - not dominant. Small legible text: red maker plate on the truck frame (top centre, 'Kawasaki') and 'Princeton Tec' on the headlamp strap. 4887 x 3464. title: USACE continues repairs at 17th Street Canal PCCP, 6 March 2024 - 1
creator: Team New Orleans, U.S. Army Corps of Engineers
alt: Seen from behind, a contractor in a yellow hard hat, clear face shield, work gloves and hi-vis vest grinds the steel suction intake inside a pump bay at a New Orleans canal pumping station, sparks spraying across the curved metal wall.
notes: 17th Street Canal Permanent Canal Closures and Pumps (PCCP) station, New Orleans, Louisiana, USA; 2024-03-06. Per the USACE caption, workers grind the formed suction intake adapter in the bay of Pump 4 to prepare it for anode studs (pump-station maintenance). Worker is a construction contractor, not military; no face visible. Small logos: 'Kiewit' on the hard hat, Nike swoosh on the hoodie sleeve; vest print 'Think! Safety - Nobody gets hurt'. Proper PPE (hard hat, full face shield, gloves). Caveat: sparks inside a steel pipe read as metalwork more than 'water' - the card label should name pump stations. 4847 x 3225. US federal government work (Flickr: Public Domain Mark 1.0; Commons: PD-USGov-Military-Army-USACE, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:USACE_continues_repairs_at_17th_Street_Canal_PCCP,_6_March_2024_-_1.jpg). Licence re-checked on the Flickr photo page and on the Commons file page.

title: Elizabeth Engine Replacement
creator: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Norfolk District
